sql.if: AND DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} ||'%' OR SUGGEST_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} ||'%' OR USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} ||'%'

mapper.select: WITH U AS( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUGGEST_BOARD_NO DESC) RNUM, T.*, D.DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT SUGGEST_BOARD_NO, SUGGEST_CONTENT, SUGGEST_DATE, S.USER_NO, SUGGEST_TITLE, SUGGEST_STATUS ,(SELECT B.USER_NM FROM TB_USER B WHERE B.USER_NO = S.USER_NO) USER_NM FROM SUGGEST_BOARD S ) T, EMPLOYEE E, DEPT D WHERE T.USER_NO = E.USER_NO AND E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO AND SUGGEST_STATUS = 1 ) SELECT *FROM U WHERE RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT T.*, D.DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT SUGGEST_BOARD_NO, SUGGEST_CONTENT, SUGGEST_DATE, S.USER_NO, SUGGEST_TITLE, SUGGEST_STATUS ,(SELECT B.USER_NM FROM TB_USER B WHERE B.USER_NO = S.USER_NO) USER_NM FROM SUGGEST_BOARD S ) T, EMPLOYEE E, DEPT D WHERE T.USER_NO = E.USER_NO AND E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO AND SUGGEST_STATUS = 1) WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT SUGGEST_BOARD_NO, SUGGEST_CONTENT, SUGGEST_DATE, B.USER_NO, SUGGEST_TITLE, SUGGEST_STATUS,USER_NM FROM SUGGEST_BOARD B, TB_USER U WHERE B.USER_NO = U.USER_NO AND SUGGEST_BOARD_NO = #{suggestBoardNo}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SUGGEST_BOARD(SUGGEST_BOARD_NO, SUGGEST_CONTENT, USER_NO, SUGGEST_TITLE ) VALUES((SELECT NVL(MAX(SUGGEST_BOARD_NO),0)+1 FROM SUGGEST_BOARD),#{suggestContent},#{userNo},#{suggestTitle} )
SELECT MAX(SUGGEST_BOARD_NO) FROM SUGGEST_BOARD
mapper.select: WITH T AS( SELECT REP_NO, PARENT_NO, R.SUGGEST_BOARD_NO, REP_REG_DATE , REP_CONTENT, REP_STATUS, REP_USER, USER_NM FROM REPLY R, SUGGEST_BOARD S, TB_USER T WHERE R.SUGGEST_BOARD_NO = S.SUGGEST_BOARD_NO AND REP_USER = T.USER_NO AND REP_STATUS = 1 AND S.SUGGEST_BOARD_NO = #{suggestBoardNo} ) SELECT T.REP_NO, T.PARENT_NO, T.SUGGEST_BOARD_NO, T.REP_REG_DATE , T.REP_CONTENT, T.REP_STATUS, T.REP_USER, T.USER_NM , LEVEL LVL FROM T START WITH T.PARENT_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR T.REP_NO = T.PARENT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.REP_NO
